question: What doctrinal restriction is placed on giving this Kaula teaching, distinguishing a worthy recipient from any unqualified person?
premises: This Kaula teaching is to be given to the worthy.
It is not to be given to just anyone.
The restriction is reinforced by an indefinite relative reference to any person.
inference: The doctrine restricts transmission of this Kaula teaching to the worthy alone, prohibiting its giving to the unqualified.
uncertainties: The criteria for 'the worthy' are not specified within this verse.
plain_english: This Kaula is to be given to the worthy; it is not to be given to just anyone.
